ChangeText: ALERT! Berks County South Campus Closed Monday, October 5:

Name: Berks County
ChangeText: The Berks County South Campus will be closed to staff and the public on Monday, October 5, to complete a scheduled electrical utility project. The South Campus Building will be without power from 8 am to 5 pm while Met-Ed conducts this work. For safety reasons, no one will be permitted to enter or access the South Campus building for any reason between 8 am to 5 pm on October 5.

Name: Berks County
ChangeText: The County appreciates the public’s understanding and apologizes for any inconvenience this temporary closure may cause.
